neet_phy_u20_t04_1.working: Both wires share the same support and are at the same temperature. So yielding of the support and thermal expansion affect both equally. Measuring extension relative to the reference wire cancels these errors.

neet_phy_u20_t04_4.working: A is true: loading and unloading readings are averaged. R is false: averaging reduces errors from elastic lag/hysteresis, while temperature errors are compensated by the reference wire.

neet_phy_u20_t04_5.working: Correct relation is Y = (Mg/l)·L/(πr^2), so Statement I is wrong because the expression is inverted. Statement II is wrong: the largest error comes from the diameter, which is small and enters squared, while L contributes only 0.1%.
